note: The OLG identifies pensions and retirement benefits as a type of unearned income (Unearned Income Overview page) and includes them in the Verification Chart as mandatory verification for non-categorically eligible SNAP households. The Work Number page notes that pension payments from former employers may appear in that database. The OLG also has general guidance on asking open-ended and follow-up questions during interviews (Application Interview, Recertification Interview pages) and a framework for investigating questionable/contradictory information. However, the OLG does not address the specific FNS requirement to proactively explore a household's employment history for possible pension eligibility, nor does it provide guidance on what to do when employment history suggests possible entitlement to a pension that the household denies receiving. The FNS requirement to 'fully explore and document the basis for their determination' when circumstances indicate possible pension entitlement has no OLG equivalent specific to pensions. Union benefits are not mentioned at all in the OLG as an income type to inquire about.
